# Attico Panoramico Milazzo

> Independent holiday apartment (penthouse) in the historic centre of Milazzo, Sicily, Italy, run directly by its owners. Panoramic terrace with sea view, private garage, up to 8 guests, a 15-minute walk from the port for the Aeolian Islands. Italiano: casa vacanze indipendente all'ultimo piano nel centro storico di Milazzo, con terrazza panoramica vista mare e garage privato.

- Address: Via Cristoforo Colombo 7, 98057 Milazzo (ME), Sicily, Italy
- Coordinates: 38.22509, 15.24127
- Official website: https://www.atticopanoramico.it/
- National ID code (CIN): IT083049C2FNPHRA9D · Regional code (CIR): 19083049C206347
- Contact and booking: WhatsApp +39 388 077 5449
- Guest ratings: Airbnb 5.0/5 (84 reviews), Booking.com 9.8/10 (22 reviews), Vrbo 9.6/10 (5 reviews)

## Frequently asked questions

- **What is Attico Panoramico Milazzo?** Attico Panoramico Milazzo is an independent holiday apartment on the top floor of a building in the historic centre of Milazzo, Sicily, run directly by its owners. It has a panoramic terrace with sea view and a private garage, sleeps up to 8 guests and is a 15-minute walk from the port where hydrofoils and ferries leave for the Aeolian Islands.
- **Where is the Attico Panoramico in Milazzo located?** The apartment is at Via Cristoforo Colombo 7, in the historic centre of Milazzo (ME), Sicily. It is just steps from restaurants, bars, supermarkets, beaches and the port for the Aeolian Islands.
- **How many guests can the penthouse accommodate?** The apartment (about 160 m², plus the terrace) sleeps up to 8 guests. It has 3 bedrooms (two doubles and one with two single beds), a double sofa bed in the living room, 2 bathrooms, a fully equipped kitchen and a panoramic terrace.
- **Is parking included?** Yes, the apartment includes a private garage with remote-controlled access, at no extra cost.
- **What are the check-in and check-out times? Is there a minimum stay?** Check-in is from 5:00 pm and check-out by 11:00 am. The minimum stay is 2 nights.
- **Are pets allowed?** No, pets are not allowed in the apartment.
- **What is the apartment's rating?** The Attico Panoramico is rated 5.0 out of 5 on Airbnb, with 84 guest reviews. On Booking.com it scores 9.8 out of 10 (22 reviews) and on Vrbo 9.6 out of 10 (5 reviews).
- **How do I contact the owner to book?** Write to us on WhatsApp at +39 388 077 5449: it is the quickest way to ask about availability and book.
- **What is there to see in Milazzo?** Milazzo offers the Castle and fortified Citadel (the largest in Sicily, over 7 hectares), Cape Milazzo with the Venus Pool, the Ponente and Baia del Tono beaches, the historic centre with its pedestrian area, the Sanctuary of San Francesco di Paola and the MuMa — Sea Museum.
- **How do you reach the Aeolian Islands from Milazzo?** The port of Milazzo is a 15-minute walk from the apartment. Hydrofoils and ferries connect all 7 Aeolian Islands (Lipari, Vulcano, Salina, Stromboli, Panarea, Filicudi, Alicudi), ideal for day trips.
- **How do you get to Milazzo?** From Catania Fontanarossa (CTA): 1h40 via the A18+A20 motorway. From Palermo Falcone-Borsellino (PMO): 2h15 via the A20. From Messina: 35 minutes via the A20. Milazzo also has a railway station on the Messina–Palermo line.
